content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a chairman of the board position at Nokia. Tell about your experience in leading a global technology giant, strategic guidance, and creating shareholder value. Also describe how you have renewed the company's strategy and built sustainable competitive advantage. Length about 380 words.
